messages:
Jordan Lee: kicking off ApertureX onboarding 10-min thread to align owners, acceptance gates, and a tight 10-day pilot plan. ApertureX wants Private (VPC) deployment, KMS/HSM for keys, and a compact SOC2 evidence bundle. Pilot flag target: 2026-11-03. Key contacts: Marta (IT lead), Ken (PM). High-level goals: 95th pct latency <=210ms under pilot bursts, uptime >=99.9%, quality pass rate >=92% on a 500-sample eval. Cost sensitivity: aim < $0.014/token during pilot. Who picks infra vs enablement?

Marta Ibarra: ApertureX prefers afternoons PST 10/27-10/30 for handoffs. I'll provide staging IP allowlist and a service account. Two asks: 1) can logs be limited to 21d during pilot? 2) we need a pre-signed SOC2 evidence export for our compliance team.

Ken Park: I'll own product acceptance criteria and the eval set. Proposal: acceptance gate = 95th pct <=210ms AND eval pass rate >=92% during a continuous 45-min validation window at pilot rate. If either fails, we keep the feature flag off and revert to hosted fallback. Also want a canary plan.

Priya Gomez: Ill run enablement sessions and calendar invites. Recommend 3 sessions: infra handoff (10/27 15:00 PST), prompts workshop (10/29 10:00 PST), monitoring + runbook (10/31 11:00 PST). Sending invites now.

Arun Singh: I can lead infra integration and the smoke tests. Recommend a q4 quantized variant for throughput; we'll enable batching + KV cache. Need staging creds to validate routing. Sample smoke test I'll run after creds:
```
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \\  -d '{"model":"aperture-llama-q4","input":"ping"}'
```
I'll attach a harness that asserts 95th/99th pct latencies and triggers rollback on breaches. Planning PR by EOD 10/20.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated: infra handoff scheduled; SOC2 export queued at /onboarding/aperturex/documents.

Marta Ibarra: will post staging creds + allowlist to the secure vault and ping infra. Also confirming 21d logs retention ok for pilot.

Ken Park: clarifying canary: propose 10% for 1 hour, 30% for 2 hours, full if gates pass. Need automated rollback if quality or latency breach occurs.

Arun Singh: confirmed  I'll add canary policy and dashboard panels for 50/95/99 pct and error rate, plus a quality signal from the eval harness. Automation will abort canary on either latency or quality regressions.

Priya Gomez: action items I captured: 1) Arun: infra config PR + harness + rollback + dashboards (due 10/20). 2) Jordan: publish SOC2 export & onboarding docs (due 10/21). 3) Priya: invites & agendas (sent). 4) Marta: staging creds & allowlist (ASAP). Reconvene after infra handoff to validate smoke test.

Marta Ibarra: creds and allowlist uploaded to vault; pinged your team. :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: thanks everyone  I'll publish a short recap after infra handoff and tag owners @Arun @Priya @Marta @Ken. :white_check_mark:
